problems.title: Nonperturbative QCD and Yang-Mills: construction, mass gap, confinement and hadron structure
problems.open_question: How does four-dimensional non-Abelian gauge theory rigorously exist and generate a positive mass gap and confinement, and how does nonperturbative QCD generate hadron mass and spin?
problems.field_level_impact: This is a Clay Millennium Prize problem and a foundation of the theoretical explanation of strongly interacting matter.

recognition_evidence.authority: US DOE Nuclear Science Advisory Committee

recognized_subproblem_domains: rigorous continuum-limit or spectral-gap bounds
certified confinement observables tied to the continuum theory
nonperturbative mechanisms with explicit universality tests
excluded_as_standalone: a solver or truncation benchmark without continuum or confinement consequences

problems.title: Finite-density QCD phase structure
problems.open_question: What is the phase diagram of QCD at finite baryon density, and does a critical point or first-order transition exist?
problems.field_level_impact: The answer controls the understanding of strongly interacting matter in heavy-ion collisions and compact stars and is a central nuclear-science program.

recognition_evidence.authority: US DOE Nuclear Science Advisory Committee
Snowmass Lattice Gauge Theory Topical Group

recognized_subproblem_domains: controlled methods that overcome or delimit the finite-density sign problem
critical-region inference joining lattice calculations and public collision data
equation-of-state constraints with audited continuation and systematic errors
excluded_as_standalone: generic sign-problem toy models with no QCD consequence
algorithm speedups without a new physical exclusion or phase constraint

problems.title: Microscopic nature of dark matter
problems.open_question: What microscopic degrees of freedom constitute dark matter, and how do they interact with visible matter and themselves?
problems.field_level_impact: Dark matter is a core science driver spanning underground experiments, accelerators, astronomy and cosmology.
recognized_subproblem_domains: cross-experiment public-data constraints on motivated candidate classes
systematics-robust tests combining direct, indirect, collider and cosmological probes
model-independent exclusions with reproducible likelihoods
excluded_as_standalone: a new benchmark point without cross-probe or model-class consequences

problems.title: Origin and nature of neutrino mass
problems.open_question: What generates neutrino masses, what is their ordering and absolute scale, how large is leptonic CP violation, and are neutrinos Dirac or Majorana particles?
problems.field_level_impact: These questions drive major oscillation, cosmology and neutrinoless-double-beta-decay programs and probe physics beyond the Standard Model.

recognition_evidence.authority: US DOE Nuclear Science Advisory Committee

recognized_subproblem_domains: reproducible global fits joining oscillation, cosmology and beta-decay constraints
nuclear-matrix-element uncertainty audits that alter Majorana sensitivity
robust CP and mass-ordering inference with explicit degeneracy tests
excluded_as_standalone: one-channel parameter refinements below current systematic uncertainty
phenomenology scans without a falsifiable experimental interface

problems.title: Nature of the Higgs sector and electroweak symmetry breaking
problems.open_question: Is the observed Higgs field fundamental and unique, what is its potential, and what dynamics set and stabilize the electroweak scale?
problems.field_level_impact: The Higgs sector is a central particle-physics science driver connected to mass generation, new particles, vacuum stability and the early universe.
recognized_subproblem_domains: global EFT constraints that distinguish Higgs-sector mechanisms
self-coupling and electroweak-phase-transition inference
cross-channel tests of additional or composite Higgs sectors
excluded_as_standalone: one Wilson coefficient or one-loop correction with no global consequence

problems.title: Physical origin of inflation and cosmic acceleration
problems.open_question: What physics drove primordial inflation and the present accelerated expansion, and are they caused by fields, vacuum energy or modified gravity?
problems.field_level_impact: Inflation and dark energy determine the origin and fate of cosmic structure and are major particle-physics and astronomy priorities.
recognized_subproblem_domains: model-independent reconstruction using public cosmological data
systematics audits of tensions that distinguish early- and late-universe mechanisms
falsifiable primordial signatures with cross-survey forecasts
excluded_as_standalone: one graph alphabet or correlator identity
one dataset tension without a systematic-error and model-comparison audit

problems.title: Origin of the cosmic matter-antimatter asymmetry
problems.open_question: Which beyond-Standard-Model dynamics generated the observed baryon asymmetry of the universe?
problems.field_level_impact: The Standard Model does not explain why a matter-dominated universe survived, connecting collider, neutrino, EDM, flavor, phase-transition and gravitational-wave programs.

recognition_evidence.authority: US DOE Nuclear Science Advisory Committee

recognized_subproblem_domains: joint exclusions of testable baryogenesis or leptogenesis mechanisms
CP- and lepton-number-violation constraints with complete uncertainty propagation
electroweak phase-transition predictions linked to collider and gravitational-wave probes
excluded_as_standalone: a parameter scan disconnected from reachable observables
a model variant with no discriminating signature

problems.title: Quantum gravity, black-hole information and emergence of spacetime
problems.open_question: How does spacetime and semiclassical gravity emerge from quantum degrees of freedom, and how are black-hole evaporation and interiors compatible with unitary quantum mechanics?
problems.field_level_impact: A quantum description of gravity is a fundamental gap in present physics; black holes provide its sharpest consistency tests.

recognition_evidence.authority: Snowmass Quantum Gravity String Theory and Black Holes Topical Group

recognized_subproblem_domains: exact models that test universal claims about information recovery or spacetime emergence
holographic or de Sitter consistency conditions with explicit observable consequences
amplitude and double-copy structures tied to quantum-gravity consistency rather than isolated algebra
excluded_as_standalone: one amplitude alphabet, graph family or integral identity without a quantum-gravity consequence
